title: BidResponse
name: dev.uap.demand.bid_response
description: A demand agent's reply to an AdRequest. An empty `bids` array is a valid no-bid and MUST NOT be treated as an error.
$comment: Maps to an OpenRTB 2.6 BidResponse. A demand agent implementing this endpoint participates in hosted decisioning. Real-time bidding is not the only way in: a buyer may instead ship line items to the exchange for inclusion in campaign bundles, which requires no low-latency infrastructure at all and is how Profile L supply is filled. See docs/documentation/integration.md.

no_bid_reason.description: Why no bid was returned. Optional but strongly encouraged.
no_bid_reason.$comment: A seller cannot improve fill it cannot diagnose. Silent no-bids are the reason sellers on the open web run blind for months; returning a reason costs the buyer nothing and is the difference between a floor that gets tuned and one that does not.

placement_id.description: The placement this bid is for.

deal_id.description: Present when bidding into a pre-negotiated deal.

seat.description: Buyer seat, matched against seats_allowed and seats_blocked.

pricing.description: Exactly one amount member must be present, matching `model`.

attribution.$comment: Conversions are reported by the advertiser or through an AP2 payment mandate reference, never by the serving node. The node has no way to observe a conversion and every incentive to guess high.
